title: Alberuni’s India, volume 1, chapters on the Earth
lineage: Inspected source passages; local file is paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: English translation pages 276–277 records al-Biruni quoting Brahmagupta on the followers of Aryabhata and Earth motion. This is a mediated textual report, not evidence that al-Biruni read Aryabhata directly.
